test_checklist.zh: 从2.25.2更新；安装器与F6显示2.25.3 alpha1，个人配置及其他Mod保留。切换中英文检查文字与125%缩放清晰度。
test_checklist.en: Update from 2.25.2; verify 2.25.3 alpha1 in the installer and F6, preserving settings and other mods. Check both languages and clarity at 125% scaling.

test_checklist.zh: F6输入框短按和长按退格可删字，不触发暂停；关闭F6后游戏原生按键恢复。改键和切出窗口后再返回也应正常。
test_checklist.en: In F6 text fields, tap and hold Backspace to delete without pausing. After closing F6, normal game keys work. Repeat after rebinding and switching windows.

test_checklist.zh: 快速任务与任务内换机均能用CFA-50、CFA50、FA50、241找到同一机体；其他已装Mod机可见，未解锁DLC继续受限。
test_checklist.en: Both quick-mission and in-mission lists find the same aircraft using CFA-50, CFA50, FA50 or 241. Installed mod aircraft remain visible; unowned DLC stays restricted.

test_checklist.zh: F17V、ADF-11、F-15EX两型：对照机库、SP1至3选择页与任务HUD，确认作者兵装名称一致，不误回退通用编号。
test_checklist.en: Compare hangar, SP1–3 selection and mission HUD names on F17V, ADF-11 and both F-15EX variants; retain author-provided weapon names.

test_checklist.zh: S32选IRCM加其他SP出击；激活IRCM后切SP/MSL，确认持续、弹药和装填独立，游戏内等待至少15秒确认自然结束及尾迹回收，再激活并重试。GAF-1、XR-302如已安装再复核。
test_checklist.en: On S32, select IRCM with another SP. Activate, switch SP/MSL and check duration, separate ammo/reload and natural ending after at least 15 in-game seconds. Repeat; also check installed GAF-1 and XR-302.

test_checklist.zh: 普通Su-57、DarkStar、XFA-33 A/C逐机测试：SP1/SP2互切、切SP3及MSL、半开时切换、真实发射；分别观察本体门和挂架是否收回，关闭多挂外观再复核。
test_checklist.en: Test standard Su-57, DarkStar and XFA-33 A/C individually: SP1/SP2 switching, SP3/MSL, mid-opening switches and actual firing. Observe body doors and racks separately; repeat with multi-mount visuals disabled.

test_checklist.zh: XFA-33 B及Su-57 TGM：全开和半开时SP互切不应重复从零展开；SP回MSL仍正常关闭，发射正常。分别检查本体与挂架，关闭多挂外观再复核。
test_checklist.en: On XFA-33 B and Su-57 TGM, SP switching while fully or partly open should retain progress. SP to MSL still closes normally and firing works. Check body doors and racks separately; repeat with multi-mount visuals off.

test_checklist.zh: CFA-50：ADMM/TLS互切及转EML时顶部门正常收拢；MSL直接转EML不误开顶部，EML回MSL机腹正常关闭；单EML与三SP都检查。
test_checklist.en: On CFA-50, check ADMM/TLS switching and upper-door closing when selecting EML. MSL directly to EML must not open the upper bay; EML to MSL closes the lower bay. Check single EML and triple SP.

test_checklist.zh: 上述机体补给重配、检查点重开、退出再出击后复核；对比不操作和频繁切SP的帧数/短卡。记录机型、组合、外观开关、动作、本体或挂架及卡顿；适配失效后重新出击再测。
test_checklist.en: Repeat after resupply/reconfiguration, checkpoint restart and re-sortie. Compare idle and frequent-switch FPS/stutters. Report aircraft, loadout, visuals setting, action, body/rack behavior and stutters; re-sortie after fallback.

test_checklist.zh: 主菜单快速出击成功后，在任务内改为三SP组合，确认三槽可切换、发射、装填；检查快速任务卡片在日志上方，M13仍保留任务指定SP。
test_checklist.en: After quick launch, select a triple-SP loadout in mission and verify all slots switch, fire and reload. The quick-mission card stays above logs; M13 retains its assigned SP.

test_checklist.zh: 安装器导出通用ZIP：ReadMe_EN和ReadMe_zhCN请读我各四份TXT，英文文件名为英文；安装器和F6正文与对应语言一致。
test_checklist.en: Export the universal ZIP from the installer: four TXT files each in ReadMe_EN and ReadMe_zhCN请读我, with English filenames for English documents. Verify installer/F6 document language consistency.

test_checklist.zh: 原生机常用三SP、CFA-44及FALKEN回归；CFA-50长按功能按原生姿态条件检查，区分30秒ECM/3秒波纹与僚机20秒ESM。F-14IA继续隔离，APS混装限制仍属预期。
test_checklist.en: Regress common native triple-SP loadouts, CFA-44 and FALKEN. For CFA-50 hold-button behavior, respect native attitude requirements and distinguish 30-second ECM/3-second ripple from wingman 20-second ESM. F-14IA remains isolated and APS mixing restrictions remain expected.
